restoration_note: Teaching 95 describes the senses as a populated cosmic battlefield: 200,000 divine seals against 200,000 archons of darkness, sorted daily by election/purification/inward gathering vs. expulsion into Error. The text is heavily fragmentary. Editorial restorations of mid-letter mechanical completions are accepted with high confidence: ⲣ̄ⲓ chapter number (0), letters within ⲙ̄ⲙⲏⲛⲉ 'daily' (8), ⲕⲉⲧⲃⲁ 'another myriad' (11), ⲛ̄ⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ 'archons' (12), ⲡ- article before ⲍⲁⲣⲕ 'stillness' (17), ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth' (21, 27), ⲡⲙⲉⲧⲁⲣⲣⲓⲥⲙⲟⲥ (23, 24), ⲍⲙ ⲡⲙⲉⲧⲁⲗⲗⲓⲥⲙⲟⲥ (29, 30), and 3pl object suffix (31). All other lacunae — particularly the long 12-18 character spans (7, 9, 10, 13, 14, 25) and the short ambiguous gaps where no parallel formula constrains the fill (1-5, 15, 16, 18-20, 22, 26, 28) — are left unrestored. The text's two-host doctrine is recoverable as a whole, but the local formulaic realizations are too damaged to invent without speculation.
